content:
matt: kicking off VPC/connectivity smoke run for eu-west-4 cluster (gpu-cluster-08). will attach TGW, set up egress NAT, and delegate private DNS. tagging this thread for net handoff
anya: on it. TF apply finished for tgw-attach + vpc attachments. attachment state shows PENDING_ACCEPTANCE in console. can someone accept the tgw attachment?
ravi: accepted the attachment and propagated routes to the TGW route table. quick traceroute from jumpbox -> 10.0.11.3 showed a blackhole at transit gw route table (no route to the subnet cidr).
kevin: found the issue: the subnet route table wasn't associated with the TGW propagation table. fixed association and re-propagated. please retest.
matt: re-run traceroute when you can. also validate egress path (NAT) and DNS delegation.
anya: traceroute now reaches node, latency ~12ms, no hops dropped.
sara: FYI enabling 3 NAT gateways immediately will spike costs. recommend start with 1 NAT + elastic IP pool and enable burst autoscaling after smoke tests.
matt: agreed. set nat-gw-count=1 for now. we'll enable one additional NAT if throughput > 2Gbps during tests.
ops-bot: [infra] tgw-route-propagation: success for tgw-0abc123 in eu-west-4
deploy-bot: [deploy] kube bootstrap job started on gpu-cluster-08. status: pending nodes 0/24
ravi: noticed BGP session with partner vpc (shared transit) flapped twice during attach. looked like an ASN mismatch (ours 64512, peer 64512) but hold timers were 60s. reduced hold-time mismatch on peer fixed flaps. monitoring.
kevin: added static routes for management subnets to go via TGW attachment id tgw-attach-045. also added a route target for the dedicated-monitoring VPC.
matt: DNS checks: need delegation from private zone redwood-internal to eu-west-4 private hosted zone (gpu-cluster-08.internal). sara, can you confirm the zone ID and that glue records exist for PR CNAMEs?
sara: zone id created: Z12345EUW4. pushed change-set to route53 but need the delegated NS records from core-internal. asking platform-dns to accept.
anya: running quick dig from probe in eu-west-4:

```bash
# from probe
dig +short cluster.gpu-cluster-08.internal NS @10.0.0.2
# expected delegated NS entries
```

anya: dig returned empty until Route53 delegation accepted. once delegation is in, SRV lookups for kube-apiserver should resolve.
matt: run the kube healthcheck once DNS resolves. healthcheck checklist: kube-apiserver SRV, etcd endpoints, kubelet node registration, containerd socket on GPU nodes, control plane metrics reachable from monitoring vpc.
ravi: I ran kube-apiserver SRV lookup manually after delegation and got 3 records. apiserver certs seem fine. etcd endpoints healthy.
kevin: GPU node bootstrapping hit a hiccup: iptables rule in userdata was blocking kubelet egress to s3 for image pulls. removed rule and requeued node bootstrap.
sara: confirming NAT egress: http/s requests from nodes are now passing through nat-1 and using eip-54.23.11.9
matt: load test plan for egress: run container image pulls on 8 nodes simultaneously, monitor NAT throughput and NAT gateway connections. if we hit >70% of 1Gbps sustained, spin second NAT.
ops-bot: [cost-alert] projected monthly cost for eu-west-4 with 3 nat-gws + tgw = high. current plan with 1 nat-gw looks acceptable for weeks 1-2.
sara: also reminder: set up NAT gateway lifecycle tagging for chargeback: team=gpu, env=preprod, owner=@matt
matt: handoff: ravi to own the end-to-end smoketest and confirm green for routing, nat, dns, and node bootstrap. anya to follow up with platform-dns for NS delegation acceptance. kevin to watch for iptables/userdata drift on node images. sara to manage NAT scaling and cost tracking. i'll update runbook and mark this cluster as "net-smoke: in-progress" in the tracker.
ravi: starting E2E smoke run now. will post results here.
kevin: small note for oncall: if you see intermittent BGP flaps, check ASN hold timers and verify peer config on transit peer (peer-asn mismatches were root cause earlier).
matt: thanks all. tagging @oncall-network for visibility. will do final handoff to platform-ops after E2E green. :thumbsup:
